usage_weighted_denominator_definition: unique numeric usage records whose normalized player name appears in at least one D5-applicable transfer; the numerator additionally requires a unique source-team/player join. This is a recoverable D5 identity-resolution proxy, not overall D5 feature coverage or a full-population denominator.
